name_reason: Current name says 'outro' but the function is direction-agnostic and is driven in BOTH directions by callers. Hard evidence: fd2_spell_selection_menu_main @ 0x1cff0 calls it twice -- a slide-IN loop 'for (n=0xb; -1<n; n--)' (frame 0xB->0, panels slide in) AND a slide-OUT loop 'for (i=0; i<0xc; i++)' (frame 0->0xB, panels slide out). The body just maps frame_idx 0..0xB to panel positions; the caller's iteration order chooses intro vs outro. The plate already documents 'each open/close screen drives this both intro 0xB->0 and outro 0->0xB', confirming 'outro' is a misnomer. Proposed name reflects 'render one composite frame of the status/menu panel slide' and matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> + the file's sibling fd2_slide_panel_*_step naming. No address residue in current name; this is a semantic-accuracy fix, not address cleanup.
purpose: Render one frame (frame_idx 0..0xB) of the 12-frame status/menu-panel slide animation, compositing left/right/middle panels at frame-dependent offsets onto a workspace and flushing to mode-13h VRAM. Used bidirectionally: callers drive frame 0xB->0 for slide-in, 0->0xB for slide-out.
logic_summary: 1) memmove(workspace, snapshot_b, 64000) resets workspace to the clean background snapshot. 2) Left panel: x_left = 5 while frame<6, else 5-(frame*0x10-0x60) (slides left as frame increases); always painted via fd2_paint_status_panel_layer_left. 3) Right panel: if 3<=frame<9 y_right=7-(frame*0x10-0x30) (slides up); elif frame<=2 y_right=7; else (frame>=9) skip drawing; painted via fd2_paint_status_panel_layer_right. 4) Middle panel: only when frame<6, fd2_slide_panel_up_partial_step(frame*0x10+0x5E,...). 5) memmove(0xA0000, workspace, 64000) composites the workspace to VRAM. Verified equivalent to the disassembly @ 0x18409 (EBX=frame_idx, ESI=workspace, [ESP+0x14]=src_buffer, [ESP+0x10]=snapshot_b).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step(uint32 frame_idx, uint32 workspace, uint32 src_buffer, int snapshot_b)

Maps to data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr at call sites. NOTE: live Ghidra has this MISNAMED as 'frame_idx' -- it is the snapshot source, not the frame index (the real frame index is ordinal 0).

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is compositing one slide frame into the workspace and onto mode-13h VRAM at 0xA0000.
